analyses.title: Two-minute soundscape
analyses.description: The example recording shipped with BirdNET-Analyzer: a two-minute morning soundscape with several songbirds. No location or date is attached, so the range and season check and the map are skipped.
analyses.license: Distributed with the MIT-licensed BirdNET-Analyzer repository

analyses.title: Rain and wind (test clip)
analyses.description: Thirty seconds stitched from six ESC-50 clips, three of rain and three of wind, in file order. It is not a field recording. It shows the audio quality checks and what a result with no species looks like.
analyses.attribution: ESC-50 (Piczak 2015), clips from freesound.org/s/17367, freesound.org/s/21189, freesound.org/s/26222, freesound.org/s/137296, freesound.org/s/29532, freesound.org/s/47709.
